text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, hmm, hmm. ♪ We totally kicked butt!
You know what? You're crazy strong when your gloves come off.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふふ～ん、
大勝利ね♪
しっかしあんた本気だすと、
とんでもなく強いわね。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: What happened to all of that pep just now?!
text_block_list.orig_text: さっきまでのハイテンションはどこにいった！？

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text:
I told you.
It's just a pile of rocks. Rocks aren't edible.
I'm so hungry... I'm starving!
text_block_list.orig_text:
だって～
石だし～、
食べられませんし～
お腹すいた～……
お腹すいた～……
